pages.text: $(thing)Leather$() is tough material from animal hides. It is needed for $(l:mechanics/armor)Armor$(), $(thing)Saddles$() and a $(l:metalworking/bellows)Bellows$(). A $(thing)Raw Hide$() goes through $(l:crafting/leather_making#soaking)soaking$(), $(l:crafting/leather_making#scraping)scraping$(), $(l:crafting/leather_making#preparing)preparing$() and $(l:crafting/leather_making#tanning)tanning$() to become leather.
First you need $(thing)Raw Hide$(), dropped by many $(l:the_world/wild_animals)Animals$() when slaughtered. Different animals leave hides of different size.
pages.title: Raw Hide

pages.text: The work needs:$(li)$(l:crafting/barrels#limewater)Limewater$(): burnt lime (the powder of $(thing)Lime$()) dissolved in water$(li)Water$(li)$(l:crafting/barrels#tannin)Tannin$(): an acid liquid steeped from certain tree bark$(li)$(thing)Raw Hides$()$(br2)With these ready, you can begin.
First the raw hide is $(thing)soaked$() to clean it and loosen what is not wanted. Leave the hide sealed six hours or longer in a $(l:crafting/barrels#limewater)barrel of limewater$().
A soaked hide must then be $(thing)scraped$() of what is left. Lay it on the side of a $(thing)Log$(), and $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on each part of it with a $(thing)Knife$(): its texture changes.
pages.title: Scraping

pages.text: When the hide is fully scraped, break it to take a $(thing)Scraped Hide$().
Seal the scraped hide in a $(l:crafting/barrels)barrel$() of $(thing)Water$() and leave it six hours or more: a last cleaning before tanning.
At last the prepared hide is sealed in a $(l:crafting/barrels#tannin)barrel of Tannin$(), which turns it to leather. After another six hours take the $(thing)Leather$() out.
